name: Cholera & mosquito-borne
summary: Cholera has killed thousands in DR Congo, including the conflict-hit east, as the country also fights Ebola
state: WHO has counted more than 125,000 suspected cholera cases and 3,644 deaths in DR Congo since the start of 2025 (Ver Angola, citing WHO). UN agencies say cases spiked in October in a country also fighting Ebola, with the conflict-affected east among the worst hit (UN News). This meets the Alert line for a large, high-mortality outbreak in a conflict zone.
for_you: Travellers to affected areas should follow NaTHNaC and WHO advice on food and water safety.
rubric_hit: Large high-mortality outbreak in a conflict zone = Alert

sources.title: UN News — DR Congo: Cholera cases spike amid fight against Ebola
Ver Angola — WHO warns of more than 125,000 suspected cholera cases and 3,644 deaths in DR Congo

why: Climate-sensitive diseases — cholera, dengue, chikungunya, Oropouche, West Nile and yellow fever — are hitting record levels and reaching new regions.
drivers: Conflict, floods, heat, El Niño, water and sanitation, mosquito range expansion.

rubric.alert: Large outbreaks with high mortality in conflict zones, or a WHO grade 3 emergency.
rubric.watch: Record-level seasons, or local transmission in countries where the disease was not established (including Europe).
